position disagrees with spx-b6 at the same epoch, so it is not counted as the target
Catalogue frame-quality scores were unavailable for the WISE frames from 2010 (cryogenic), 2010 (three-band), so those frames were checked by their measured pixel noise instead.
313 of 335 SPHEREx spectrum points are left out (305 where the target saturates the detector, 8 where too much of the target is covered by bad pixels).
The Gaia DR3 and CatWISE2020 lists were reused from the view built on 15 Nov 2026, because the catalogue services did not answer.
The spectrum is not classified because only 5 of its points between 1.0 and 5.0 µm are usable, and at least 8 are needed to compare it with the templates.
The target saturates some frames (W1, W2, spx-b1, spx-b2, spx-b3, spx-b4, spx-b5, spx-b6); positions there are less reliable.
